name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: In Duskwood, the search for Stormwind's missing diplomat follows a lead from Watcher Backus to Defias papers at Addle's Stead.

sections.title: A Lead in the Gloom
sections.body: Watcher Backus of the Night Watch brings the search to Duskwood. He says an unusually large gathering of Defias bandits came to Addle's Stead several weeks ago. The bandits usually keep to themselves across the border in Westfall, so their gathering in the dark woods marks an unusual move. Now you search the abandoned farmstead for the papers they left behind.

sections.title: The Defias Docket
sections.body: At the overrun farmstead, you find a locked footbox holding a Defias Docket. The papers confirm the brotherhood's involvement, but Watcher Backus warns you to be cautious. The Defias could have forged them to mislead investigators.

faq.answer: Addle's Stead lies in western Duskwood, just south of the main road from Westfall. Hostile Defias agents occupy the run-down farmhouse.
The Defias Docket is a collection of official-looking papers in a footbox at Addle's Stead. It details some of the Brotherhood's recent covert operations in the region.
Watcher Backus is a member of the Night Watch stationed in Duskwood. His contacts in town and watch over border threats help him track unusual Defias movements along the Westfall border.

faq.q: Why are Defias operating inside Duskwood?
faq.answer: Defias operatives make quiet incursions into western Duskwood, though their stronghold lies across the border in Westfall. Addle's Stead is an isolated waypoint away from Stormwind patrols.

faq.q: Can the contents of the Defias Docket be trusted?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus warns that the Defias may have planted false leads to throw investigators off their trail. The docket looks authentic, but its contents may be misdirection.

faq.q: Who originally pointed investigators toward Watcher Backus?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus says Elling Trias, a cheese merchant and covert information broker in Stormwind, directed the investigation to the Night Watch in Duskwood.

angles.text: The kingdom's missing emissary puts Stormwind's security at risk. Defias intrigue reaches far beyond petty highway robbery in Westfall.
As a rogue, you must navigate criminal networks and tell genuine intelligence from Defias misdirection.
